remarks:
This beautiful condo in the highly sought after Ransom Oaks community offers the perfect blend of low-maintenance living and exceptional amenities. Perfectly situated along the scenic Glen Oak Golf Course on the fifth hole, you'll enjoy picturesque views and a peaceful setting right from your own backyard. Residents also have access to community pools and tennis courts, creating a lifestyle that's as relaxing as it is active.

Inside, you'll find a bright, open-concept layout where the kitchen flows seamlessly into the dining and opens to the living area—ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Living room features beautiful built ins and hardwood flooring. Granite counter tops in kitchen. 2 bedrooms and a full bathroom upstairs and a half bath downstairs. Step outside to enjoy your morning coffee on the front deck or unwind on the newly built private back deck overlooking the golf course. An attached garage provides added convenience and extra storage as well as the partially finished basement area. Updated Furnace/ AC. 

This Ransom Oaks condo offers an unbeatable combination of location, comfort, and community amenities. Golf course views, resort-style recreation, and maintenance-friendly living—this is one you won't want to miss!
